lessons.code:
import numpy as np
x=np.linspace(0,1,20);y=np.sin(6*x)
z=.4;w=np.maximum(0,1-(abs(x-z)/.3)**3)**3
X=np.c_[np.ones(len(x)),x]
b=np.linalg.lstsq(X*np.sqrt(w[:,None]),y*np.sqrt(w),rcond=None)[0]
print(b[0]+b[1]*z)

import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import t
x=np.arange(10.);X=np.c_[np.ones(10),x];y=1+2*x+np.sin(x)
b=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0];s2=np.sum((y-X@b)**2)/(len(y)-2)
u=np.array([1.,11.]);se=np.sqrt(s2*(1+u@np.linalg.inv(X.T@X)@u))
print(u@b+np.array([-1,1])*t.ppf(.975,8)*se)
